value.name: Aspect is not a fixed property of linguistic expressions: stimuli
value.description: Every stimulus of White, Grimm, & Glass (2026). 312 event descriptions built around 40 English transitive verbs (20 manner/result pairs, seven semantic classes) at three points on a generality cline: 166 contentful sentences (two per PropBank roleset x concreteness sub-sense), 106 bleached counterparts, and 40 templatic 'X verb-PAST Y' items. Also the 582 Experiment 1b stimuli (an event description plus an in/for temporal modifier), the 750 Experiment 2 test pairs, and the 8 Experiment 2 calibration pairs.
